name: Toaru Otoko no Netorare Nikki
original_name: とある男の寝取られ日記
source:
He's been happily married for three years, but his wife lately has been acting strange. To get proof of her indiscretion, he begins to film her with a video camera.

Love lost, cuckoldry found, through the viewfinder of home video.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE071224.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
他已经过了三年幸福的婚姻生活，妻子最近却举止反常。为了掌握她不忠的证据，他开始用摄像机暗中拍摄。

爱在家庭录像中消逝，寝取则于取景框内显现。

[内容取自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE071224.html]DLsite English[/url]]
